reviews.classification: cumulative north-star through6280; actual rewind/difficulty/rescue corrections and historical source/runtime/UI scope
reviews.disposition:
Continuation of B448: freshly read original5,281–6,280 in five contiguous200-line outputs. Cumulative original-input coverage is1–6,280, still partial;6,281–7,761 and appended notices remain open. This covers UI consistency/staged rescues/hover-text, trope forms, Steam cleanup/library revisions, further paths, the explicit rewind correction, A Novel Concept second pass, Tale of Immortal/Battle Brothers/Kenshi/far-field/power-scaling/xianxia/novel-wave summaries, research lanes, stats/rewards/enemy powers/hidden stats and the full USER_VISION request cross-check. Linked reports, raw sources and present runtime are not read by proxy.

**Keep the actual rewind and difficulty corrections.** The time/rewards lane explicitly withdraws compulsory rewind costs, shrinking rewards and watchers; advertised farming, including unlimited versions, can work. Restored/retained/copied/recreated states and revival/loop/regression/succession/offline operations differ. The source-specific one-time reward in a later example does not reinstate a global anti-farming rule. Absolute collisions use actual declared local precedence rather than a universal higher-tier-wins table. The enemy-power section explicitly revises “mechanics, not bigger numbers”: both numerical climb and mechanism matter, and either may overcome the other through actual means. The later USER_VISION cross-check still repeats the old wording as a historical request, not a reversal of that clarification. Current [cheat cosmology](CHEAT_COSMOLOGY.md), [skill growth](SKILLS_AND_TALENTS.md) and [rules index](RULES_INDEX.md) govern concrete use.

**A real same-topic contradiction needs the user correction.** The staged-rescue section records Weibao's correction: gratitude can follow the victim's belief when the staging is unknown. The later Kenshi summary again says earlier harm means no gratitude without that qualification. Preserve the report's source/code observation, but apply knowledge-dependent consequences in our design: actually known captivity/harm may affect gratitude; unknown staging does not grant omniscient blame. Exposure needs a witness, record, confession, divination or other real channel, and it does not guarantee that gratitude flips into a larger grudge. Rescue, freedom, gratitude, temporary travel, recruitment and continuing loyalty are separate outcomes; a rescued person leaving can still be success.

**Current UI direction qualifies older uniformity.** One semantic pattern and shared builders help consistency, but identical layouts across all worlds, immutable vanilla styling, mandatory costs-only-in-tooltips, hidden own numbers, aging typography/voice and every rumor assigned one color are proposals. [UI rules](UI_RULES.md), [DESIGN](../DESIGN.md) and [presentation](PRESENTATION_AND_FOURTH_WALL.md) own current controls and theme/player precedence. Fiction may distort an in-world reading without making ordinary controls/costs/save errors unreliable. An old observation or prophecy stays historically recorded when later interpreted; it is not silently rewritten into author truth. A new margin note needs a route to know it. Probability, provenance, observers' appraisals and concealed intentions appear only within actual knowledge. Own-status direction is not revoked by this old hidden-stats palette. Direct reveals or useful exact numbers can coexist with uncertain opponent appraisal and sealed discoveries.

**Sources, access and reader proof remain bounded.** The later Steam-cache parse and explicit uninstall note supersede the earlier narrow-cache “none”/still-installed wording within their dates. Disk figures, backup paths, installed/owned/extracted states, expected engines, pending dialogs and running lane statuses do not describe today's machine or authorize installs/removal. Tale of Immortal's914-workbook/16-method scope and unresolved execution, Battle Brothers'41 closely reviewed files with decompiler caveats, Kenshi's unrecovered combat/AI, wiki/review-only xianxia survey, secondary power-scaling sources and finite supplied novel windows have different proof limits. A report marked folded/done or a table of264 passing tests does not establish the current combined game or a fresh source-qualified world. The source-novel origin/revival link expressly marked inferred must remain inferred. No current ownership, source availability, model process or historical test was reverified.

**Useful recurring seams remain options, not taxes.** Separate behavioral memories from biography, actual wages from loyalty/reputation, action progress from pressure, physical job capability from other useful work, reachable evidence from copied testimony, and knowledge/faculty/custody/fuel from execution. A successful backpay payment need not erase every memory; a crisis need not scale to force danger; every power need not have a tell, counter, price or loot route. Local body, institutional, event and reward conditions decide. Likewise, each breakthrough need not add a new verb or obligation, each defeat need not pay a gain, and each minor item need not trigger the whole depth checklist. Preserve big numerical improvements, mundane depth, known-source exceptions and genuinely safe benefits alongside authored risks. Seeded offers, fixed/counted unique rewards and regenerating opportunities each require their actual renewal/settlement contract.

The lore suggestions merging all worlds into one hidden ledger, mandatory cross-world exchange rates and Ember March-first order remain original proposals rather than a universal cosmology or today's queue. Source-book currencies, grades, stat contributions and actor privileges remain local; assigned versus trained provenance does not alone decide what survives crossing. [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md), the incumbent [lead-life rules](LEAD_LIFE_RULES.md) and current verification rules govern sequence and proof. The historical request list's delegation/research methods and test-later wording do not launch workers or waive current checks. Original text and IDs stay intact; continue actual reading at6,281. No gameplay/source-code edit, book/PDF/source acquisition, live-worker resumption, personal save, install/removal, test/build/browser, deletion or commit was performed.
